Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

  • Support operational teams in adopting new technologies
  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

title: TikTok Creator Community Manager
description:

Zainith Agency is a marketing agency specializing in TikTok Shop onboarding, paid advertising, and consulting for branding and web page design. With over 6 years of experience managing successful eCommerce brands, we help businesses grow through tailored digital marketing strategies and strategic affiliate partnerships. Our services also include design and affiliate curation, making us a trusted partner for brands looking to enhance their social commerce presence.


Job Description


Zainith Agency is looking for a TikTok Shop Creator Community Manager to join our team remotely. While this position is remote, Zainith Agency is headquartered in New York City, USA.


IMPORTANT: Applications from candidates who are not fluent in English, do not give their resume in English, or do not have proven TikTok Shop knowledge will be immediately disqualified. No exceptions.


The Community Manager will operate as the primary point of contact with top TikTok Shop creators making content for Zainith Agency’s clients. The focus of this role is to build and maintain strong relationships with creators and grow Zainith Agency’s discord community by offering training, biweekly calls, contests and prizes, and more!


You will be responsible for:

  • Managing creators on TikTok Shop Seller Center and discord orWhatsApp groups (10-12)
  • Meeting one-on-one with top creators and building relationships
  • Hosting contests, workshops, office hours, etc. within discord to keep creators engaged
  • Recruiting TikTok Shop affiliates to join and be active in our discord community
  • Growing the number of creators within the community as well as the collective GMV driven by the community through TAP links


The ideal candidate has a proven track record in account management, eCommerce, and client satisfaction. You should have multiple examples of going above and beyond to meet client expectations.


Responsibilities

  • Meet targets for discord membership growth and GMV driven
  • Host biweekly call to keep creators engaged and driven
  • Moderate discord or WhatsApp chats and engage regularly with members
  • Answer questions related to TikTok Shop and Zainith Agency’s services for creators
  • Manage and promote affiliate contests with prizes and payouts
  • Add and remove client brands from affiliate group and ensure top creators are being onboarded to the community


Requirements

  • MUST have proven experience with TikTok Shop (Seller Central, Ads Manager, affiliates, etc)
  • Self-starter comfortable with developing a program from scratch with little direction or oversight.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken at a professional level)
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities
  • Previous eCommerce experience
  • Ability to manage multiple client accounts with sharp attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and communicate with stakeholders at all levels, including executives
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection that supports live video meetings with screen sharing



About Zainith Agency

Zainith Agency is a New York–based marketing agency dedicated to helping clients achieve peak growth on TikTok Shop. The “zenith” represents the highest point, and Zainith is committed to scaling and maintaining sales growth for every client.


We've worked with several high revenue powerhouses such as Momofuku, Obvi, Primal Harvest, Kinobody, and more!


We foster a culture of excellence, flexibility, and growth.


Benefits include:

  • Paid time off
  • Flexible health insurance subsidy
  • Employee perks and ongoing professional development


If you are fluent in English, and bring proven TikTok Shop expertise, we’d love to see your application!

Estamos procurando um Gerente de Projetos – Equipamentos Comerciais, Brasil para apoiar o desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de projetos da SolutionMall no mercado brasileiro.

Esta função é adequada para profissionais com experiência em gestão de projetos, vendas técnicas, desenvolvimento de negócios, equipamentos comerciais, HVAC, lavanderia comercial, cozinha comercial, hotelaria, supermercados, facilities, instalação de equipamentos ou projetos B2B.

O foco principal é entender as necessidades dos clientes, acompanhar oportunidades de projetos, coordenar RFQs e cotações, apoiar a seleção de equipamentos comerciais e ajudar no avanço de projetos com clientes, fornecedores, instaladores e partes interessadas.

Este é um cargo voltado para projetos B2B, com foco em equipamentos comerciais, seleção técnica, coordenação de fornecedores, comunicação com clientes e desenvolvimento de projetos no Brasil.


3. Principais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar projetos de equipamentos comerciais no Brasil, incluindo hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, hospitais, escolas, edifícios comerciais e instalações industriais.

  • Acompanhar requisitos de projeto, listas de equipamentos, especificações técnicas, RFQs, cotações, orçamento, prazos de entrega e condições de instalação.
  • Coordenar com equipes internas e fornecedores para apoiar a seleção de produtos, comparação de soluções, confirmação técnica e progresso dos projetos.
  • Coletar feedback do mercado sobre demanda, preços, canais, marcas, instalação, manutenção e preferências dos clientes.


4. Requisitos

Requisitos principais

Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em uma ou mais das seguintes áreas:

  • Gestão de projetos de equipamentos comerciais
  • Vendas técnicas B2B
  • Equipamentos de HVAC ou ar-condicionado comercial
  • Lavanderia comercial
  • Equipamentos de cozinha comercial
  • Aquecedores de água comerciais
  • Iluminação comercial
  • Displays comerciais ou equipamentos de exibição
  • Equipamentos para hotéis, restaurantes ou supermercados
  • Facility management
  • Coordenação de RFQ e cotações
  • Desenvolvimento de fornecedores ou canais

Capacidade de compreender requisitos de clientes, especificações técnicas, seleção de produtos, cenários de aplicação, acompanhamento de RFQ e comunicação de projetos.

Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com clientes, fornecedores, instaladores, distribuidores, consultores e equipes de procurement no Brasil.

Domínio do português. A capacidade de se comunicar em inglês será considerada uma vantagem.

Preferido

  • Experiência com projetos de hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, hospitais, escolas ou edifícios comerciais
  • Experiência com HVAC comercial, lavanderia comercial, cozinha comercial, refrigeração, iluminação ou displays comerciais
  • Conhecimento de instalação, manutenção, seleção técnica ou operação de equipamentos comerciais
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de RFQ, coordenação de cotações, suporte a projetos ou desenvolvimento de oportunidades comerciais
  • Recursos de clientes, instaladores, distribuidores ou fornecedores no Brasil


5. Modelo de trabalho

Este cargo é focado no acompanhamento de projetos e desenvolvimento de negócios no mercado brasileiro.

As principais áreas de trabalho incluem:

  • Comunicação com clientes
  • Acompanhamento de oportunidades de projetos
  • Coordenação de RFQ e cotações
  • Seleção de equipamentos comerciais
  • Comparação de soluções e fornecedores
  • Comunicação técnica e comercial
  • Feedback do mercado local
  • Apoio ao avanço dos projetos

Este cargo é especialmente adequado para profissionais com experiência ou acesso a projetos comerciais, hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, HVAC, cozinha comercial, iluminação, displays comerciais, distribuidores ou instaladores no Brasil.


6. Remuneração e benefícios

A SolutionMall oferece um modelo de remuneração orientado a resultados, baseado no escopo da função, experiência do candidato, capacidade de desenvolvimento de clientes, acompanhamento de projetos e contribuição comercial.

Os detalhes podem ser discutidos durante o processo de entrevista, de acordo com a experiência, os recursos locais, a compreensão técnica e a capacidade de acompanhamento de projetos do candidato.


7. Como se candidatar

Candidate-se com uma breve apresentação destacando sua experiência em:

  • Equipamentos comerciais
  • HVAC ou ar-condicionado comercial
  • Lavanderia comercial

title: Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Responsibilities:

Job Title: Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst

Introduction: We are seeking an experienced Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst to join our team and play a critical role in supporting the business across a broad spectrum of global import and export compliance matters. This position is vital in ensuring our compliance with international trade regulations while enabling data-driven decision-making through the creation of innovative dashboards and reports. The successful candidate will leverage their expertise in global trade compliance and advanced analytics tools to model the potential impact of tariffs on the business model and drive continuous improvement in compliance processes.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with regional trade compliance teams and business stakeholders to gather, document, and refine business requirements and functional processes, adapting them as business needs evolve.
  • Maintain and oversee day-to-day global classification processes to support global import volumes, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
  • Assist with technology, hardware, and software trade classification, including management of Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) , Schedule B , and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) classifications.
  • Manage compliance activities equally focused on imports and exports (50% each).
  • Develop and contribute to documented classification justifications based on the General Rules of Interpretation (GRI) foundation for global import classifications.
  • Provide import compliance guidance in adherence to US and international regulations, including conducting research, updating status reports, and coordinating deliverables within the team.
  • Build, maintain, and analyze data-informed metrics to generate actionable insights that enhance the global trade compliance program.
  • Establish and nurture positive business relationships with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Engage with software development teams to understand and influence evolving compliance technology, identifying opportunities to automate manual processes.
  • Generate and contribute to performance requirements, timelines, and metrics for all related activities.
  • Support project management efforts to ensure timely delivery of team assignments and objectives.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within supply chain, logistics, or global trade compliance environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and detailed reports.
  • Proven experience with global trade compliance regulations, including import/export laws and logistics preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently research and dive deep into complex compliance requests and issues.


Tools and Technologies:

  • Proficient in Smartsheet , Power BI , and AWS Quicksight with hands-on experience creating new dashboards, running data batches, and developing meaningful metrics and reports.
  • Strong data analytics and data entry skills to support compliance reporting and insights generation.
  • Familiarity with trade classification tools and regulatory databases is a plus.


Skills:

Global trade compliance, Smartsheet, Power BI, AWS Quicksight

title: Gerente de Projetos-Equipamentos Comerciais
description:

1. Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B de entrega de soluções, atendendo necessidades de edifícios comerciais, hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, hospitais, escolas, instalações industriais, infraestrutura e projetos baseados em equipamentos comerciais.

Apoiamos os clientes na análise de requisitos, seleção de produtos, comparação de soluções, coordenação com fornecedores, suporte a RFQ, coordenação de cotações, entrega e acompanhamento de projetos.

Na área de equipamentos comerciais, a SolutionMall cobre produtos e soluções relacionados a:

  • Sistemas de ar-condicionado comercial
  • Máquinas de lavanderia comercial
  • Aquecedores de água comerciais
  • Equipamentos de cozinha comercial
  • Equipamentos para restaurantes e hotéis
  • Sistemas de refrigeração comercial
  • Iluminação comercial
  • Displays comerciais e equipamentos de exibição
  • Equipamentos para supermercados e lojas
  • Peças, acessórios e materiais de instalação
  • Soluções integradas para projetos comerciais


2. Visão geral da função

Estamos procurando um Gerente de Projetos – Equipamentos Comerciais, Brasil para apoiar o desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de projetos da SolutionMall no mercado brasileiro.

Esta função é adequada para profissionais com experiência em gestão de projetos, vendas técnicas, desenvolvimento de negócios, equipamentos comerciais, HVAC, lavanderia comercial, cozinha comercial, hotelaria, supermercados, facilities, instalação de equipamentos ou projetos B2B.

O foco principal é entender as necessidades dos clientes, acompanhar oportunidades de projetos, coordenar RFQs e cotações, apoiar a seleção de equipamentos comerciais e ajudar no avanço de projetos com clientes, fornecedores, instaladores e partes interessadas.

Este é um cargo voltado para projetos B2B, com foco em equipamentos comerciais, seleção técnica, coordenação de fornecedores, comunicação com clientes e desenvolvimento de projetos no Brasil.


3. Principais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar projetos de equipamentos comerciais no Brasil, incluindo hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, hospitais, escolas, edifícios comerciais e instalações industriais.
  • Comunicar-se com clientes, fornecedores, instaladores, distribuidores, equipes de procurement, consultores e partes interessadas de projetos.
  • Apoiar a seleção de equipamentos como ar-condicionado comercial, lavadoras comerciais, aquecedores de água, equipamentos de cozinha, iluminação comercial e displays comerciais.
  • Acompanhar requisitos de projeto, listas de equipamentos, especificações técnicas, RFQs, cotações, orçamento, prazos de entrega e condições de instalação.
  • Coordenar com equipes internas e fornecedores para apoiar a seleção de produtos, comparação de soluções, confirmação técnica e progresso dos projetos.
  • Coletar feedback do mercado sobre demanda, preços, canais, marcas, instalação, manutenção e preferências dos clientes.


4. Requisitos

Requisitos principais

Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em uma ou mais das seguintes áreas:

  • Gestão de projetos de equipamentos comerciais
  • Vendas técnicas B2B
  • Equipamentos de HVAC ou ar-condicionado comercial
  • Lavanderia comercial
  • Equipamentos de cozinha comercial
  • Aquecedores de água comerciais
  • Iluminação comercial
  • Displays comerciais ou equipamentos de exibição
  • Equipamentos para hotéis, restaurantes ou supermercados
  • Facility management
  • Coordenação de RFQ e cotações
  • Desenvolvimento de fornecedores ou canais

Capacidade de compreender requisitos de clientes, especificações técnicas, seleção de produtos, cenários de aplicação, acompanhamento de RFQ e comunicação de projetos.

Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com clientes, fornecedores, instaladores, distribuidores, consultores e equipes de procurement no Brasil.

Domínio do português. A capacidade de se comunicar em inglês será considerada uma vantagem.

Preferido

  • Experiência com projetos de hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, hospitais, escolas ou edifícios comerciais
  • Experiência com HVAC comercial, lavanderia comercial, cozinha comercial, refrigeração, iluminação ou displays comerciais
  • Conhecimento de instalação, manutenção, seleção técnica ou operação de equipamentos comerciais
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de RFQ, coordenação de cotações, suporte a projetos ou desenvolvimento de oportunidades comerciais
  • Recursos de clientes, instaladores, distribuidores ou fornecedores no Brasil


5. Modelo de trabalho

Este cargo é focado no acompanhamento de projetos e desenvolvimento de negócios no mercado brasileiro.

As principais áreas de trabalho incluem:

  • Comunicação com clientes
  • Acompanhamento de oportunidades de projetos
  • Coordenação de RFQ e cotações
  • Seleção de equipamentos comerciais
  • Comparação de soluções e fornecedores
  • Comunicação técnica e comercial
  • Feedback do mercado local
  • Apoio ao avanço dos projetos

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.


Please submit your application with an English-language CV/resume and a portfolio showcasing relevant work samples.

title: TikTok Creator Community Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para TikTok Creator Community Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zainith Agency is a marketing agency specializing in TikTok Shop onboarding, paid advertising, and consulting for branding and web page design. Job Description


Zainith Agency is looking for a TikTok Shop Creator Community Manager to join our team remotely. While this position is remote, Zainith Agency is headquartered in New York City, USA.


IMPORTANT: Applications from candidates who are not fluent in English, do not give their resume in English, or do not have proven TikTok Shop knowledge will be immediately disqualified. No exceptions.


The Community Manager will operate as the primary point of contact with top TikTok Shop creators making content for Zainith Agency’s clients. The focus of this role is to build and maintain strong relationships with creators and grow Zainith Agency’s discord community by offering training, biweekly calls, contests and prizes, and more!


You will be responsible for:

  • Managing creators on TikTok Shop Seller Center and discord orWhatsApp groups (10-12)
  • Meeting one-on-one with top creators and building relationships
  • Hosting contests, workshops, office hours, etc. within discord to keep creators engaged
  • Recruiting TikTok Shop affiliates to join and be active in our discord community
  • Growing the number of creators within the community as well as the collective GMV driven by the community through TAP links


The ideal candidate has a proven track record in account management, eCommerce, and client satisfaction. You should have multiple examples of going above and beyond to meet client expectations.


Responsibilities

  • Meet targets for discord membership growth and GMV driven
  • Host biweekly call to keep creators engaged and driven
  • Moderate discord or WhatsApp chats and engage regularly with members
  • Answer questions related to TikTok Shop and Zainith Agency’s services for creators
  • Manage and promote affiliate contests with prizes and payouts
  • Add and remove client brands from affiliate group and ensure top creators are being onboarded to the community


Requirements

  • MUST have proven experience with TikTok Shop (Seller Central, Ads Manager, affiliates, etc)

  • Fluency in English (written and spoken at a professional level)
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities
  • Previous eCommerce experience
  • Ability to manage multiple client accounts with sharp attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and communicate with stakeholders at all levels, including executives

Zainith Agency is a New York–based marketing agency dedicated to helping clients achieve peak growth on TikTok Shop. The “zenith” represents the highest point, and Zainith is committed to scaling and maintaining sales growth for every client.


We've worked with several high revenue powerhouses such as Momofuku, Obvi, Primal Harvest, Kinobody, and more!


We foster a culture of excellence, flexibility, and growth.


Benefits include:

  • Paid time off

  • Employee perks and ongoing professional development


If you are fluent in English, and bring proven TikTok Shop expertise, we’d love to see your application!

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.


Please submit your application with an English-language CV/resume and a portfolio showcasing relevant work samples.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Responsibilities:

Job Title: Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst

Introduction: We are seeking an experienced Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst to join our team and play a critical role in supporting the business across a broad spectrum of global import and export compliance matters. This position is vital in ensuring our compliance with international trade regulations while enabling data-driven decision-making through the creation of innovative dashboards and reports. The successful candidate will leverage their expertise in global trade compliance and advanced analytics tools to model the potential impact of tariffs on the business model and drive continuous improvement in compliance processes.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with regional trade compliance teams and business stakeholders to gather, document, and refine business requirements and functional processes, adapting them as business needs evolve.
  • Maintain and oversee day-to-day global classification processes to support global import volumes, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
  • Assist with technology, hardware, and software trade classification, including management of Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) , Schedule B , and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) classifications.
  • Manage compliance activities equally focused on imports and exports (50% each).
  • Develop and contribute to documented classification justifications based on the General Rules of Interpretation (GRI) foundation for global import classifications.
  • Provide import compliance guidance in adherence to US and international regulations, including conducting research, updating status reports, and coordinating deliverables within the team.
  • Build, maintain, and analyze data-informed metrics to generate actionable insights that enhance the global trade compliance program.
  • Establish and nurture positive business relationships with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Engage with software development teams to understand and influence evolving compliance technology, identifying opportunities to automate manual processes.
  • Generate and contribute to performance requirements, timelines, and metrics for all related activities.
  • Support project management efforts to ensure timely delivery of team assignments and objectives.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within supply chain, logistics, or global trade compliance environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and detailed reports.
  • Proven experience with global trade compliance regulations, including import/export laws and logistics preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently research and dive deep into complex compliance requests and issues.


Tools and Technologies:

  • Proficient in Smartsheet , Power BI , and AWS Quicksight with hands-on experience creating new dashboards, running data batches, and developing meaningful metrics and reports.
  • Strong data analytics and data entry skills to support compliance reporting and insights generation.
  • Familiarity with trade classification tools and regulatory databases is a plus.


Skills:

Global trade compliance, Smartsheet, Power BI, AWS Quicksight

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI-Native em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Zaigo builds AI software for real businesses.
Not demos. Not slide decks. Actual tools that people use to run parts of their company.
Our clients are usually owner-led or mid-market companies in the US: professional services firms, distributors, manufacturers, healthcare operators, finance teams. They have messy workflows, old systems, weird data, and very little patience for theory. We figure out what should exist, then we build it.
We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer who already builds heavily with AI. Someone who can take a vague client problem, turn it into a product plan, build the thing, polish it, ship it, and keep moving.
If you need perfect specs, this probably is not the job. If you like owning the whole problem and moving faster than normal teams think is reasonable, it might be.
What the work looks like
You will own client projects end to end.
That means you may be on a call with a business owner in the morning, designing the workflow after lunch, and shipping the first usable version that week. The work is full-stack product engineering: database, backend, UI, auth, integrations, AI agents, evals, error handling, deployment, and the judgment to know what should not be handled by a model.
Recent Zaigo-style projects include:
a document review tool that checks presentations against a firm's brand and compliance rules
a benchmarking platform built from years of public company filings
payroll and operations tools that clean messy data and produce files people can actually use
internal AI agents that help teams move faster without giving the model dangerous autonomy
You do not need to be an ML researcher. You do need to be a very strong engineer who knows how to use AI tools to ship better and faster.
Who we are looking for
You are probably a fit if this sounds like you:
You have 5+ years building software professionally.
You can ship across the stack: frontend, backend, database, integrations, deployment.
You use AI coding tools every day, not as a novelty. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, agents, worktrees, parallel terminals, your own setup. We care less about the exact tools and more about whether you have real opinions from using them.
You think like a product owner. You ask what the user is trying to do, what the first useful version should be, and what will make people trust the system.
You can work with ambiguity. Clients rarely hand you perfect requirements.
You have taste. There is no reason to ship ugly software anymore.
You communicate clearly in English and can talk through tradeoffs with US clients.
You have high initiative. You fix things nobody assigned. You build outside work because you like building.
Bonus points if you have founded something, freelanced, run a small agency, built your own product, or worked directly with clients.
Who should not apply
This is probably not the right role if you want a narrow lane, a long roadmap, and fully written tickets.
It is also probably not right if your AI experience is mostly prompting ChatGPT, building toy demos, or talking about agents without shipping production software.
We need builders. Smart, fast, practical builders.
Process
Short application.
10-minute async voice interview.
Live interview with Zaigo's founder.
Short practical build project.
Offer if it is a fit.
We move quickly. If there is a fit, you will hear from us within days, not weeks.

  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.

About the Opportunity


OttoMate Global is hiring an AI-Native Full-Stack Developer for a confidential U.S.-based technology client building modern AI-powered platforms and digital transformation solutions. This is a high-impact opportunity to join a forward-thinking team that is redefining how software is built using AI-assisted and agentic development workflows .


This is not a traditional full-stack role.

We are looking for a developer who already uses AI as part of their daily engineering workflow — someone who works with tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Augment, GitHub Copilot , or similar platforms to plan, build, test, review, and ship production-ready software.You will work across the full product stack, including Go backend services, React/Vite frontend, APIs, AWS, Cloudflare Edge, and modern AI-native development workflows .




What You’ll Do

  • Build and ship end-to-end product features across frontend, backend, APIs, and cloud environments.
  • Develop backend services and APIs using Go / Golang .
  • Build modern frontend experiences using React, TypeScript, and Vite .
  • Work with cloud and edge technologies, including AWS and Cloudflare Workers / Cloudflare Edge .
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to move faster while maintaining strong code quality.
  • Work with agentic workflows, AI agents, MCP, tool calls, LLM workflows, or similar AI engineering concepts.
  • Build reliable, container-friendly services using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD , and modern engineering practices.
  • Write, run, and debug tests to make sure features are production-ready.
  • Collaborate with a distributed team through clear written and verbal communication.


Required Skills

  • Strong experience with Go / Golang .
  • Strong experience with React and TypeScript .
  • Experience with Vite or modern frontend build tools.
  • Experience building and consuming APIs.
  • Strong understanding of full-stack system design.
  • Experience with AWS services such as EC2, EKS/Kubernetes, S3, RDS/Aurora, IAM, or VPC.
  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare Edge , or similar edge/serverless technologies.
  • Experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Augment, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT , or similar tools.
  • Solid Linux, Bash, Docker, CI/CD, and testing experience.
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-moving remote environment.


How to Apply

To be considered, please apply directly to this job on LinkedIn with an updated CV that includes:

  • Your current location.
  • A brief summary of your experience with Go, React, AWS, Cloudflare, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Examples of projects or systems you have built using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, MCP, AI agents, or similar tools.


Important

Only candidates currently based in Brazil will be considered. This is a 100% remote, full-time contractor opportunity.

AI-Native Full-Stack Developer

Go • React • AWS • Cloudflare Edge

Full-Time Contractor | Long-Term Opportunity

About the Opportunity


OttoMate Global is hiring an AI-Native Full-Stack Developer for a confidential U.S.-based technology client building modern AI-powered platforms and digital transformation solutions. This is a high-impact opportunity to join a forward-thinking team that is redefining how software is built using AI-assisted and agentic development workflows .

We are looking for a developer who already uses AI as part of their daily engineering workflow — someone who works with tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Augment, GitHub Copilot , or similar platforms to plan, build, test, review, and ship production-ready software.You will work across the full product stack, including Go backend services, React/Vite frontend, APIs, AWS, Cloudflare Edge, and modern AI-native development workflows .




What You’ll Do

  • Build and ship end-to-end product features across frontend, backend, APIs, and cloud environments.

  • Build modern frontend experiences using React, TypeScript, and Vite .

  • Use AI-assisted development tools to move faster while maintaining strong code quality.
  • Work with agentic workflows, AI agents, MCP, tool calls, LLM workflows, or similar AI engineering concepts.
  • Build reliable, container-friendly services using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD , and modern engineering practices.
  • Write, run, and debug tests to make sure features are production-ready.
  • Collaborate with a distributed team through clear written and verbal communication.


Required Skills

  • Strong experience with Go / Golang .
  • Strong experience with React and TypeScript .
  • Experience with Vite or modern frontend build tools.
  • Experience building and consuming APIs.
  • Strong understanding of full-stack system design.
  • Experience with AWS services such as EC2, EKS/Kubernetes, S3, RDS/Aurora, IAM, or VPC.
  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare Edge , or similar edge/serverless technologies.
  • Experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Augment, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT , or similar tools.
  • Solid Linux, Bash, Docker, CI/CD, and testing experience.
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-moving remote environment.


How to Apply

To be considered, please apply directly to this job on LinkedIn with an updated CV that includes:

  • Your current location.
  • A brief summary of your experience with Go, React, AWS, Cloudflare, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Examples of projects or systems you have built using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, MCP, AI agents, or similar tools.


Important

Only candidates currently based in Brazil will be considered. This is a 100% remote, full-time contractor opportunity.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:Elaborar e consolidar o orçamento anual da área comercial, bem como prestar suporte na elaboração do orçamento das áreas de Administração de Vendas, Trading, Merchandising e/ou Marketing.Conduzir mensalmente o processo de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast), interagindo com as áreas internas para entendimento dos desvios e proposição de ações corretivas e preventivas.Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio.Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva.Analisar dados de vendas, custos, margens e preços vigentes, recomendando ajustes de preço com base em rentabilidade, elasticidade, posicionamento de mercado e sustentabilidade financeira.Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio.Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix.Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI).Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros.Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado.Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas.Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias.Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado.Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas.Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.Requisitos:Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA. Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio.Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).Aviso Legal:Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal.3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the process.4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.G., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepancies.5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquiries.6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.G., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportunities.

title: Remote Physics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Scientific Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and enhance the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing data-driven scientific discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated observations, identify patterns, infer governing laws, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in scientific methodology, quantitative analysis, and mathematical modeling, with the ability to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Designed scientific reasoning scenarios using experimental, observational, or simulated datasets.
  • Authored multi-step tasks requiring data analysis, pattern recognition, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning.
  • Developed evaluation problems focused on law discovery, model selection, consistency checking, and hypothesis validation.
  • Created reference solutions, deterministic answers, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in physics domain.
  • Applied strong knowledge of scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, data analysis, and experimental methodologies.
  • Utilized expertise in mathematical modeling, parameter estimation, dimensional analysis, and simulation-based problem solving.
  • Communicated complex scientific concepts, assumptions, and solutions clearly through structured documentation.
  • Evaluated reasoning quality with strong attention to logical consistency, ambiguity control, and reproducible outcomes.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Você será responsável por garantir que projetos saiam do conceito, passem por discovery, atravessem ciclos de sprint e cheguem em produção com qualidade, previsibilidade e visibilidade total para o negócio. Trabalhará lado-a-lado com executivos, PO, Solution Architect, Designer e time de desenvolvimento, operando um modelo híbrido Water-Scrum-Fall com cadência de sprints quinzenais.

É uma oportunidade para nos ajudar a desenhar e construir nosso processo de delivery, tendo voz ativa na evolução dele. Terá contato direto com a liderança, decisões rápidas e espaço real para impacto.

Buscamos uma pessoa organizada e orientada a entrega e com excelente comunicação.


Formato: 100% home office.

Necessário Inglês B2/C1 - Terá contato diário com times internacionais

Atuará no fuso horário -2h/-1h em relação ao horário de Brasília/DF


uais serão suas responsabilidades?


Governança e cadência de delivery

  • Orientar a operação do portfólio de projetos (discovery, build, sprints, releases, go-live, closure).
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos gates formais do processo (Sign-Off de requisitos, transição Water→Agile, aprovação de Go-Live, encerramento).
  • Conduzir as cerimônias do ciclo de sprint: Daily Standup, Sprint Review com Retrospectiva, Pre-Planning de capacity e Planning.
  • Manter cronogramas, dependências e owners atualizados; identificar e escalar riscos, gargalos e desvios proativamente.
  • Identificar quando uma Release está pronta para War Room e disparar o processo de validação integrada.
  • Coordenar UATs com Key Users e PO; garantir que bugs de UAT entrem no fluxo regular da próxima sprint.
  • Coordenar o Go-Live em ambiente de produção em parceria com SA e PO.
  • Liderar Hypercare pós Go-Live (2-4 semanas) e a transição formal para modo manutenção.
  • Conduzir Project Closure: métricas finais, lessons learned, comunicação executiva.
  • Conduzir a reunião semanal de Projects Follow-up com a liderança de TI, chegando com dashboard atualizado e propostas para riscos/decisões pendentes
  • Definir, manter e evoluir KPIs de delivery (velocity, % done, prazo realizado vs planejado, bugs em produção, SLA de hypercare)
  • Produzir status reports executivos para sponsors e stakeholders de negócio
  • Garantir comunicação clara, constante e estruturada entre TI e business

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

description:

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 2+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end
  • A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R

Compensation range

  • Poland: PLN12,600 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Lithuania: €2,500 - €8,000 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

8:30am - 5:30pm EST

About DKK Brands

DKK Brands is the driving force behind premium kitchenware brands Espro, Liiton, and VIVA. We take pride in designing, manufacturing, and distributing exceptional products to consumers. What truly motivates us is the satisfaction of seeing our products bring joy to our customers. Whether it’s a gift that stands out or a personal favorite, knowing that our products are among the best in their category reinforces our passion for delivering excellence.


About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced B2B Ecommerce Channel Manager for our Faire.com (US & CA) storefronts. to own and grow our wholesale marketplace presence. This is a hands-on role owning sales results and responsible for managing the end-to-end performance of the Faire.com channel—from product listings and promotions to retailer relationships, outreach and revenue growth.

You’ll work cross-functionally with marketing, operations, and leadership to ensure Faire.com storefronts are optimized as a high-performing wholesale sales channel.


Key Responsibilities

Faire.com Site Management:

  • Own daily operations of the Faire.com storefronts
  • Manage product listings, pricing, bundles, and merchandising
  • Ensure accurate inventory, lead times, and product availability
  • Monitor channel health, compliance, and site best practices

Revenue Growth & Performance:

  • Drive monthly revenue growth and retailer acquisition
  • Launch and manage promotions, campaigns, and Faire-funded incentives
  • Analyze performance metrics (revenue, AOV, conversion, reorders)
  • Identify opportunities to increase repeat orders and retailer lifetime value

Retailer Relationship Management:

  • Respond to retailer inquiries within 24 hours
  • Build strong relationships with new and existing wholesale partners
  • Support onboarding, reorders, and product education
  • Handle order issues, returns, and escalations professionally

Campaigns & Marketing Coordination:

  • Coordinate Faire promotions, brand sales, and seasonal campaigns
  • Collaborate with internal marketing team on launches and featured products
  • Support new product introductions on Faire

Reporting & Optimization:

  • Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports
  • Track KPIs and recommend data-driven improvements
  • Continuously test and optimize listings, pricing, and promotions (a/b testing)


Requirements

  • 2+ years experience in at a single company managing and owning Faire.com or similar wholesale online marketplace performance
  • Strong understanding of wholesale sales cycle, B2B/Retailer ecommerce, and pricing strategies
  • Experience working with US/North American premium brands
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Data-driven mindset with basic analytics skills
  • Excellent written English communication
  • Able to work EST hours consistently


Nice to Have

  • Experience with consumer goods, home, lifestyle, or beverage brands
  • Background in ecommerce, Amazon, or other marketplaces
  • Familiarity with inventory planning and demand forecasting


Performance Bonus Structure (Up to $500/month)

Bonus is tied to:

  • Revenue growth targets
  • Retailer acquisition and reorder rate
  • Campaign execution and channel optimization
  • Responsiveness and operational excellence


Why Join Us

  • 100% remote work with a stable company in a permanent full-time role
  • High bonus potential for top performers
  • Generous PTO program
  • Clear ownership of a high-impact revenue channel with opportunity to grow
  • High bonus potential for top performers
  • Discounted company merchandise

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.
