title: Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.

Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.

Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.

Who are we?


We’re a true Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up, with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.

We’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from within—with our very own team.

Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.

You can see more about our storyjourney here!


We create intuitive health and safety software that people want to use, giving businesses the visibility and data they need to prevent risks and build stronger, safer workplaces and safety cultures.


Safety isn’t just a department, it’s a culture that involves everyone, from frontline workers to the boardroom. ecoPortal makes safety simple, visible, and shared, with an intuitive interface that people actually want to use.

We help create stronger engagement, fewer incidents, and measurable improvements that drive both culture and performance.



The Role

An exciting opportunity is available at ecoPortal . We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO) Team, supporting the successful implementation of our Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance SaaS platform.


You’ll play a vital role in gathering, analysing, and finalising customer requirements, ensuring that each solution is tailored to deliver value while aligning with ecoPortal’s product capabilities and delivery standards.


As a Business Analyst , you’ll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists , and customer stakeholders to design fit-for-purpose solutions—ranging from minimal changes to standard templates through to complex, bespoke configurations. You'll need strong communication, analytical, and documentation skills, and an ability to work across technical and business teams to ensure clarity, alignment, and successful delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead customer workshops and meetings to capture, validate, and finalise business requirements in line with scope.
  • Translate customer needs into clear, technically aligned documentation using tools such as process flows, user stories, and functional specifications.
  • Support the design of both standard and custom solutions that align with ecoPortal platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Project Managers, Implementation Specialists) to ensure smooth solution delivery.
  • Proactively identify and flag risks or misalignments early, recommending alternative solutions where appropriate.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating builds against requirements and assisting with defect triage.
  • Contribute to a smooth customer transition from implementation to business-as-usual (BAU) through handover documentation.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of ecoPortal’s platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance.
  • Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience , ideally within SaaS or software implementation environments.
  • Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design capabilities.
  • Can confidently facilitate workshops and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the “what” and the “why.”
  • Is proficient in documentation practices , including process mapping, user stories, functional specs, and change logs.
  • Understands the value of collaboration and can work fluidly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Has exposure to project delivery methodologies such as Agile or Hybrid models.
  • Communicates clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing.
  • Is naturally curious and detail-oriented , with a drive to understand how things work and improve them.
  • Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC) systems – a bonus, but not required!
  • Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable.


Perks & Benefits:

37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.

End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

title: Copywriter (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Copywriter (Remote) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Charly Agency

Charly Agency is a growing digital agency specializing in web design, UX/UI, branding, ecommerce, and development for clients primarily in the US. Operating globally with offices in San Francisco and Barcelona, we partner with brands ranging from startups to enterprises. Our team is spread across Europe and Latin America and we are scaling fast.


About the Role

We are looking for a freelance copywriter to join our pool of creative collaborators. You will write across brand, web, and marketing, working closely with our design and strategy team to bring client projects to life through sharp, purposeful copy.

This is not a beginner role. We want someone who can take a brief, understand the business behind it, and produce copy that is clear, purposeful, and built to convert — without hand-holding. Mistakes happen, but high quality, great communication, and honesty are non-negotiable. No vague communication, no hiding behind \"I was waiting for feedback.\"


What You'll Do

  • Write website copy across homepages, landing pages, product pages, and about pages
  • Develop brand voice guidelines and messaging frameworks
  • Write case studies, blog posts, and marketing content
  • Collaborate with designers to ensure copy and design work together


What We're Looking For

  • Strong portfolio of web and brand copywriting
  • Excellent written English, this is non-negotiable
  • Experience writing for DTC, SaaS, B2B, or CPG brands is a plus
  • Comfortable delivering quickly under tight deadlines without sacrificing quality
  • Clear and thoughtful approach to using AI in your workflow
  • Reliable, communicative, and comfortable working async
  • Eager to learn, open to direction, and quick on feedback
  • Agency experience is a strong plus


About Us

Charly is a creative agency with a warm, international team that takes the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We collaborate across time zones, support each other, and care a lot about doing great work for clients we genuinely like. If you are kind, talented, and ambitious, you will fit right in.


To Apply, send:

  • Your strongest copywriting samples (website, landing page, or brand copy preferred)
  • Examples of projects you wrote for and your role in them
  • Your availability and preferred working hours
  • Your expected rate (hourly or per project)

title: Analista de Projetos Pleno - Inglês Avançado
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Projetos Pleno - Inglês Avançado em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Analist de Projetos/Delivery Operations Analyst para coordenar a operação ponta-a-ponta do nosso portfólio de projetos e iniciativas estratégicas de tecnologia.

Você será responsável por garantir que projetos saiam do conceito, passem por discovery, atravessem ciclos de sprint e cheguem em produção com qualidade, previsibilidade e visibilidade total para o negócio. Trabalhará lado-a-lado com executivos, PO, Solution Architect, Designer e time de desenvolvimento, operando um modelo híbrido Water-Scrum-Fall com cadência de sprints quinzenais.

É uma oportunidade para nos ajudar a desenhar e construir nosso processo de delivery, tendo voz ativa na evolução dele. Terá contato direto com a liderança, decisões rápidas e espaço real para impacto.

Buscamos uma pessoa organizada e orientada a entrega e com excelente comunicação.


Formato: 100% home office.

Necessário Inglês B2/C1 - Terá contato diário com times internacionais

Atuará no fuso horário -2h/-1h em relação ao horário de Brasília/DF


uais serão suas responsabilidades?


Governança e cadência de delivery

  • Orientar a operação do portfólio de projetos (discovery, build, sprints, releases, go-live, closure).
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos gates formais do processo (Sign-Off de requisitos, transição Water→Agile, aprovação de Go-Live, encerramento).
  • Conduzir as cerimônias do ciclo de sprint: Daily Standup, Sprint Review com Retrospectiva, Pre-Planning de capacity e Planning.
  • Manter cronogramas, dependências e owners atualizados; identificar e escalar riscos, gargalos e desvios proativamente.
  • Identificar quando uma Release está pronta para War Room e disparar o processo de validação integrada.
  • Coordenar UATs com Key Users e PO; garantir que bugs de UAT entrem no fluxo regular da próxima sprint.
  • Coordenar o Go-Live em ambiente de produção em parceria com SA e PO.
  • Liderar Hypercare pós Go-Live (2-4 semanas) e a transição formal para modo manutenção.
  • Conduzir Project Closure: métricas finais, lessons learned, comunicação executiva.
  • Conduzir a reunião semanal de Projects Follow-up com a liderança de TI, chegando com dashboard atualizado e propostas para riscos/decisões pendentes
  • Definir, manter e evoluir KPIs de delivery (velocity, % done, prazo realizado vs planejado, bugs em produção, SLA de hypercare)
  • Produzir status reports executivos para sponsors e stakeholders de negócio
  • Garantir comunicação clara, constante e estruturada entre TI e business


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Experiência prévia coordenando projetos de tecnologia, squads ou times de delivery
  • Experiência prática com Scrum/Agile e com modelos híbridos/Waterfall
  • Experiência operacional com Jira (boards, workflows, relatórios) ou ferramenta equivalente
  • Excel intermediário a avançado (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, dashboards)
  • Experiência produzindo reportes executivos e apresentações em PowerPoint
  • Experiência acompanhando KPIs e dashboards operacionais
  • Inglês avançado (B2/C1) — leitura técnica e reuniões com stakeholders globais


Como você pode se destacar?

  • Experiência em PMO, Delivery Management, Customer Success ou Operations em ambiente de tecnologia
  • Familiaridade com modelos Water-Scrum-Fall ou frameworks híbridos
  • Experiência com Power BI, Jira Analytics ou outras ferramentas de visualização
  • Experiência com automações no Jira (regras, integrações, scripts)
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas a produtividade (Copilot, ChatGPT, automações)


O que nós oferecemos?

  • Vaga remota
  • Contratação modelo CLT
  • Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategy & Operations Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 2+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end
  • A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R

Compensation range

  • Poland: PLN12,600 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Lithuania: €2,500 - €8,000 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

title: Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.

Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.

Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.

Who are we?


We’re a true Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up, with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.

We’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from within—with our very own team.

Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.

You can see more about our storyjourney here!


We create intuitive health and safety software that people want to use, giving businesses the visibility and data they need to prevent risks and build stronger, safer workplaces and safety cultures.


Safety isn’t just a department, it’s a culture that involves everyone, from frontline workers to the boardroom. ecoPortal makes safety simple, visible, and shared, with an intuitive interface that people actually want to use.

We help create stronger engagement, fewer incidents, and measurable improvements that drive both culture and performance.



The Role

An exciting opportunity is available at ecoPortal . We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO) Team, supporting the successful implementation of our Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance SaaS platform.


You’ll play a vital role in gathering, analysing, and finalising customer requirements, ensuring that each solution is tailored to deliver value while aligning with ecoPortal’s product capabilities and delivery standards.


As a Business Analyst , you’ll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists , and customer stakeholders to design fit-for-purpose solutions—ranging from minimal changes to standard templates through to complex, bespoke configurations. You'll need strong communication, analytical, and documentation skills, and an ability to work across technical and business teams to ensure clarity, alignment, and successful delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead customer workshops and meetings to capture, validate, and finalise business requirements in line with scope.
  • Translate customer needs into clear, technically aligned documentation using tools such as process flows, user stories, and functional specifications.
  • Support the design of both standard and custom solutions that align with ecoPortal platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Project Managers, Implementation Specialists) to ensure smooth solution delivery.
  • Proactively identify and flag risks or misalignments early, recommending alternative solutions where appropriate.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating builds against requirements and assisting with defect triage.
  • Contribute to a smooth customer transition from implementation to business-as-usual (BAU) through handover documentation.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of ecoPortal’s platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance.
  • Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience , ideally within SaaS or software implementation environments.
  • Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design capabilities.
  • Can confidently facilitate workshops and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the “what” and the “why.”
  • Is proficient in documentation practices , including process mapping, user stories, functional specs, and change logs.
  • Understands the value of collaboration and can work fluidly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Has exposure to project delivery methodologies such as Agile or Hybrid models.
  • Communicates clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing.
  • Is naturally curious and detail-oriented , with a drive to understand how things work and improve them.
  • Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC) systems – a bonus, but not required!
  • Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable.


Perks & Benefits:

37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.

End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Intern Business Development (Brazil) | Native Chinese Students em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About BingX


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading crypto exchange and Web3 AI company, serving over 40 million users worldwide. Ranked among the top 5 global crypto derivatives platforms and recognized as a pioneer in crypto copy trading, BingX provides a comprehensive suite of AI-driven products and services, including futures, spot trading, copy trading, and TradFi offerings.


BingX empowers users across all experience levels with innovative tools designed to enhance trading performance, confidence, and efficiency. As the principal partner of Chelsea FC since 2024 and the first official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP in 2026, BingX continues to expand its global presence and strengthen its position as a trusted, intelligent trading platform.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities


  • Formulate business development plans, assist the team in completing the introduction, negotiation, cooperation, and signing of business cooperation projects
  • Contact, negotiate, and close profitable deals with potential Affiliates or KOLs
  • Support Affiliates or KOLs and design special campaigns to increase their trading volume
  • Build partnerships with Affiliates or KOLs and promote cooperation with each other
  • Conduct research to identify new markets and customer needs
  • Build long-term relationships with new and existing Affiliates or KOLs


Requirements


  • Strong interest in business development, growth, or partnership-related roles
  • Internship, campus activity, or project experience in business development, sales, marketing, or community growth is a plus
  • Basic understanding of crypto/Web3 markets is preferred
  • Students with good communication skills in Chinese and English are essential
  • Self-motivated, eager to learn, and able to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Willing to work for more than 3 days per week, 8 hours per day


Working at BingX


  • Join a diverse, international team with a global mindset
  • Grow your career in a fast-moving Web3 and fintech environment
  • Work on meaningful products that serve millions of users worldwide
  • Enjoy competitive compensation and flexible work arrangements, depending on role requirements
  • Follow your local public holiday calendar, with additional benefits based on local policies

title: Sr Cloud Technical Architect (Observabilidade)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr Cloud Technical Architect (Observabilidade) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Função: Sr Cloud Technical Architect (Observabilidade)

Your day at NTT DATA


A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas!


Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética. #HereYouCan


What You'll Be Doing


Estamos buscando uma pessoa profissional da área de pré-vendas focado em soluções de Observabilidade , com conhecimentos consolidados nas soluções da Datadog , e conhecimento nas ferramentas de APM (Application Performance Monitoring), ELK Stack, Grafana, Splunk Observability e NPM (Network Performance Monitoring). A pessoa Sr. Technical Architect (TA) para Observabilidade deverá atuar com a elaboração de desenhos de arquiteturas de projetos mais complexos, condução de PoCs/PoVs, e atuação com o time de contas para garantir a qualidade técnica das nossas propostas de valor.


  • Horário de Trabalho: Comercial
  • Modalidade de Trabalho: Hibrido – Brasil


Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Entender requisitos de negócios do cliente;
  • Desenhar a solução técnica de observabilidade mais adequada para a demanda de negócios dos clientes;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de nossas propostas técnicas com o conteúdo técnico;
  • Apoiar na execução de PoVs/PoCs para demonstração e comprovação das soluções técnicas;
  • Apoiar no planejamento de esforços para implementação (dimensionamento de horas);
  • Compartilhar conhecimento com outros times;
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua dos produtos e serviços;
  • Participar de definições de tecnologia junto a clientes internos e externos;
  • Ser ponto focal de demandas técnicas que necessitem de direcionamento;
  • Priorização de demandas urgentes;
  • Ter viés de inovação e novas soluções disponíveis no mercado.


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Conhecimentos consolidados nas soluções da Datadog, incluindo experiencia hands-on na execução de PoVs/PoCs;
  • Conhecimentos avançados nas plataformas de APM (Application Performance Manager);
  • Conhecimentos avançados em ELK Stack;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Grafana;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Splunk Observability;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em plataformas de NPM (Network Performance Manager).

Como você pode se destacar?

  • Inglês avançado;
  • Conhecimento avançado da plataforma de APM Cisco AppDynamics;
  • Conhecimento avançado da plataforma Cisco Thousandeyes;
  • Conhecimento avançado da Stack ELK - Elasticsearch, Logstash e Kibana

O que nós oferecemos?

  • Vaga Hibrida
  • Contratação modelo CLT
  • Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Producer (Client Services & Project Coordination)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Producer (Client Services & Project Coordination) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Digital.ws

At Digital.ws, we help global brands solve complex communication challenges through creativity, technology, content, events, digital experiences, and production. We work with some of the most recognized companies in aviation, mobility, technology, and industry, delivering projects that range from social content and campaigns to websites, events, videos, branding, and interactive experiences.

We're looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, knows how to bring order to complexity, and can keep projects moving without losing sight of quality.


About the Role

As a Senior Producer, you will act as the central point connecting clients, internal teams, and external suppliers. This is a highly operational and strategic role. You will be responsible for organizing timelines, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, managing client communication, identifying risks, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and at a high standard. You should be comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a strong sense of urgency and ownership.


What You'll Do

  • Manage projects from briefing to final delivery
  • Build and maintain project schedules and production plans
  • Coordinate designers, writers, developers, video editors, 3D artists, and other specialists
  • Lead client communication and status meetings
  • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and resource conflicts before they become problems
  • Manage project scope, priorities, deadlines, and deliverables
  • Coordinate suppliers and production partners when required
  • Ensure quality control before deliveries
  • Keep internal teams aligned and informed throughout project execution


What We're Looking For:


Required

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Previous experience in agencies, studios, production companies, or communication environments
  • Strong project management and client management skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong sense of urgency and accountability
  • Experience creating and maintaining schedules, project plans, and workflows
  • Outstanding communication skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Strong Plus

  • Experience with events and experiential marketing
  • Experience with graphic production and print materials
  • Experience with digital projects, websites, and interactive experiences
  • Experience with content production and social media campaigns
  • Familiarity with ClickUp or similar project management platforms
  • Understanding of creative, digital, video, and production workflows


What Success Looks Like

  • Projects delivered on time and with quality
  • Clients feeling informed, supported, and confident
  • Teams working efficiently with clear priorities
  • Risks identified early and solved proactively
  • Multiple projects moving forward simultaneously without losing control


Additional Information

  • Full-time position
  • 100% remote
  • Candidates must be based in the State of São Paulo
  • Competitive compensation based on experience

title: Criador de Conteúdo (Sem Experiência)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Criador de Conteúdo (Sem Experiência) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Doppa é a comunidade de criadores da 3C.


Acreditamos que criar conteúdo não se aprende em curso, se aprende fazendo.

Por isso conectamos potenciais criadores com marcas dispostas a investir nesse desenvolvimento.


Nossa missão é impactar mais de 10 milhões de pessoas e apoiar seus primeiros passos nesse mundo.


Nossos três pilares são:

1. Oportunidade: Vamos te conectar com marcas dispostas a pagar por vídeos, mesmo que você ainda não tenha nem 5 seguidores.

2. Conhecimento: Nosso time é especialista em marketing digital, conteúdo e compreensão do algoritmo. E vamos compartilhar tudo que sabemos. Sem assinatura, sem curso.

3. Comunidade: Nosso grande desejo é conectar milhões de pessoas dispostas a crescerem juntos, que se ajudam e comemoram o sucesso dos outros.


Qualificações

  • interesse genuíno
  • boa comunicação
  • organização para cumprir prazos
  • noções básicas de uso de redes sociais
  • desejável familiaridade inicial com ferramentas simples de edição de imagem ou vídeo e interesse em desenvolver essas habilidades.

title: Gerente de Projetos
description:

Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos complexos e multidisciplinares;
  • Conhecimento avançado em metodologias de gestão de projetos como Agile, Waterfall e modelos híbridos;
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes e gestão de stakeholders em ambientes corporativos complexos;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e gestão de conflitos;

  • Disponibilidade para interação com times globais e realização de viagens eventuais.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Certificação em gestão de projetos como PMP ou equivalente;
  • Experiência nos segmentos farmacêutico, indústria de processos, bens de consumo, tecnologia ou consultoria;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos globais e estruturas organizacionais matriciais;
  • Experiência em PMO, transformação digital e gestão de portfólio de projetos;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot e plataformas de automação ou geração de conteúdo, aplicadas à automação de tarefas, criação de relatórios, análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão, inovação contínua e melhoria da eficiência operacional e da qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Gerenciar projetos complexos, multidisciplinares e com múltiplos stakeholders em ambientes globais e regionais;
  • Liderar todas as fases do ciclo de vida dos projetos utilizando metodologias Agile, Waterfall e modelos híbridos;
  • Elaborar e manter artefatos de gestão de projetos como Project Charter, cronogramas, relatórios executivos e documentação de transição;
  • Alinhar escopo, objetivos, entregas e estratégia com sponsors, áreas de negócio, tecnologia e parceiros externos;
  • Garantir comunicação executiva clara e eficaz sobre status, riscos, orçamento, dependências e evolução dos projetos;
  • Coordenar equipes internas multidisciplinares e fornecedores externos assegurando a execução das iniciativas;
  • Gerenciar mudanças organizacionais e do projeto por meio de comunicação estruturada e engajamento de stakeholders;
  • Controlar orçamento e centros de custo, realizando acompanhamento financeiro, previsões e relatórios executivos;
  • Desenvolver e manter cronogramas detalhados aderentes à complexidade e evolução das iniciativas;
  • Monitorar entregas garantindo conformidade com padrões de qualidade corporativos;
  • Identificar, registrar e mitigar riscos, impedimentos e impactos em conjunto com áreas envolvidas;
  • Gerenciar solicitações de mudança conforme processos formais de governança;
  • Conduzir o encerramento dos projetos incluindo retrospectivas, handover e fechamento financeiro;
  • Atuar em conformidade com políticas corporativas de ética, qualidade, segurança, meio ambiente e compliance.

title: Analista de Projetos Pleno - Inglês Avançado
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Projetos Pleno - Inglês Avançado em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Analist de Projetos/Delivery Operations Analyst para coordenar a operação ponta-a-ponta do nosso portfólio de projetos e iniciativas estratégicas de tecnologia.

Você será responsável por garantir que projetos saiam do conceito, passem por discovery, atravessem ciclos de sprint e cheguem em produção com qualidade, previsibilidade e visibilidade total para o negócio. Trabalhará lado-a-lado com executivos, PO, Solution Architect, Designer e time de desenvolvimento, operando um modelo híbrido Water-Scrum-Fall com cadência de sprints quinzenais.

É uma oportunidade para nos ajudar a desenhar e construir nosso processo de delivery, tendo voz ativa na evolução dele. Terá contato direto com a liderança, decisões rápidas e espaço real para impacto.

Buscamos uma pessoa organizada e orientada a entrega e com excelente comunicação.


Formato: 100% home office.

Necessário Inglês B2/C1 - Terá contato diário com times internacionais

Atuará no fuso horário -2h/-1h em relação ao horário de Brasília/DF


uais serão suas responsabilidades?


Governança e cadência de delivery

  • Orientar a operação do portfólio de projetos (discovery, build, sprints, releases, go-live, closure).
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos gates formais do processo (Sign-Off de requisitos, transição Water→Agile, aprovação de Go-Live, encerramento).
  • Conduzir as cerimônias do ciclo de sprint: Daily Standup, Sprint Review com Retrospectiva, Pre-Planning de capacity e Planning.
  • Manter cronogramas, dependências e owners atualizados; identificar e escalar riscos, gargalos e desvios proativamente.
  • Identificar quando uma Release está pronta para War Room e disparar o processo de validação integrada.
  • Coordenar UATs com Key Users e PO; garantir que bugs de UAT entrem no fluxo regular da próxima sprint.
  • Coordenar o Go-Live em ambiente de produção em parceria com SA e PO.
  • Liderar Hypercare pós Go-Live (2-4 semanas) e a transição formal para modo manutenção.
  • Conduzir Project Closure: métricas finais, lessons learned, comunicação executiva.
  • Conduzir a reunião semanal de Projects Follow-up com a liderança de TI, chegando com dashboard atualizado e propostas para riscos/decisões pendentes
  • Definir, manter e evoluir KPIs de delivery (velocity, % done, prazo realizado vs planejado, bugs em produção, SLA de hypercare)
  • Produzir status reports executivos para sponsors e stakeholders de negócio
  • Garantir comunicação clara, constante e estruturada entre TI e business


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Experiência prévia coordenando projetos de tecnologia, squads ou times de delivery
  • Experiência prática com Scrum/Agile e com modelos híbridos/Waterfall
  • Experiência operacional com Jira (boards, workflows, relatórios) ou ferramenta equivalente
  • Excel intermediário a avançado (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, dashboards)
  • Experiência produzindo reportes executivos e apresentações em PowerPoint
  • Experiência acompanhando KPIs e dashboards operacionais
  • Inglês avançado (B2/C1) — leitura técnica e reuniões com stakeholders globais


Como você pode se destacar?

  • Experiência em PMO, Delivery Management, Customer Success ou Operations em ambiente de tecnologia
  • Familiaridade com modelos Water-Scrum-Fall ou frameworks híbridos
  • Experiência com Power BI, Jira Analytics ou outras ferramentas de visualização
  • Experiência com automações no Jira (regras, integrações, scripts)
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas a produtividade (Copilot, ChatGPT, automações)


O que nós oferecemos?

  • Vaga remota
  • Contratação modelo CLT
  • Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

description:

ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.

Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.

We’re a true Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up, with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.

We’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from within—with our very own team.

Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.

You can see more about our storyjourney here!


We create intuitive health and safety software that people want to use, giving businesses the visibility and data they need to prevent risks and build stronger, safer workplaces and safety cultures.


Safety isn’t just a department, it’s a culture that involves everyone, from frontline workers to the boardroom. ecoPortal makes safety simple, visible, and shared, with an intuitive interface that people actually want to use.

We help create stronger engagement, fewer incidents, and measurable improvements that drive both culture and performance.



The Role

An exciting opportunity is available at ecoPortal . We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO) Team, supporting the successful implementation of our Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance SaaS platform.


You’ll play a vital role in gathering, analysing, and finalising customer requirements, ensuring that each solution is tailored to deliver value while aligning with ecoPortal’s product capabilities and delivery standards.


As a Business Analyst , you’ll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists , and customer stakeholders to design fit-for-purpose solutions—ranging from minimal changes to standard templates through to complex, bespoke configurations. You'll need strong communication, analytical, and documentation skills, and an ability to work across technical and business teams to ensure clarity, alignment, and successful delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead customer workshops and meetings to capture, validate, and finalise business requirements in line with scope.
  • Translate customer needs into clear, technically aligned documentation using tools such as process flows, user stories, and functional specifications.
  • Support the design of both standard and custom solutions that align with ecoPortal platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Project Managers, Implementation Specialists) to ensure smooth solution delivery.
  • Proactively identify and flag risks or misalignments early, recommending alternative solutions where appropriate.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating builds against requirements and assisting with defect triage.
  • Contribute to a smooth customer transition from implementation to business-as-usual (BAU) through handover documentation.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of ecoPortal’s platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance.
  • Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience , ideally within SaaS or software implementation environments.
  • Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design capabilities.
  • Can confidently facilitate workshops and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the “what” and the “why.”
  • Is proficient in documentation practices , including process mapping, user stories, functional specs, and change logs.
  • Understands the value of collaboration and can work fluidly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Has exposure to project delivery methodologies such as Agile or Hybrid models.
  • Communicates clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing.
  • Is naturally curious and detail-oriented , with a drive to understand how things work and improve them.
  • Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC) systems – a bonus, but not required!
  • Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable.


Perks & Benefits:

37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.

End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️

title: Web Content Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Web Content Producer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Web Content Producer

*Please Read*

Duration: This is expected to be a 12 month engagement

Location: Remote

Notice Period: Cannot be longer than 2 weeks

Pay: $18/hr to 25/hr USD base on hours worked or R$15,401 to R$21,391 per month

Web Content Producer

Must Haves:

  • 3+ years of web production for large enterprise sites using a CMS (Drupal 11 preferred; AEM acceptable)
  • Ability to build pages quickly using paragraph blocks, components, templates, and brand guidelines
  • Strong understanding of SEO, information architecture, and conversion‑focused page layout
  • Knowledge of WCAG 2.2 accessibility standards and thorough QA across browsers/devices
  • Working HTML/CSS/JavaScript skills for small production fixes and troubleshooting
  • Clear communication with strong problem‑solving and issue articulation
  • Advanced English for high‑accuracy editing and publishing
  • Comfort performing high‑volume manual content migration and consistent page rebuilds

Plusses:

  • Experience migrating content in structured waves (approx. 10 pages/week)
  • Familiarity with DAM tagging/metadata and analytics for performance insights
  • AEM experience and UX/UI handoff (wireframes → live pages)
  • Confidence working directly with stakeholders to clarify requirements

Day To Day:

  • The Web Content Producer will rebuild responsive pages in Drupal 11 using updated templates and paragraph components while manually migrating content from a legacy platform. Daily tasks include applying SEO and accessibility standards, performing QA across devices, troubleshooting production issues, and escalating technical blockers to developers. The role also includes maintaining organized assets within the DAM and following established workflows to ensure accuracy and brand consistency.

title: Faire.com Channel Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Faire.com Channel Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

FAIRE.COM CHANNEL MANAGER

Full-time / permanent

100% remote & outside North America

8:30am - 5:30pm EST


Up to $1,000 USD/mo base + $500/mo performance bonus

(based on experience and overall role fit)


About DKK Brands

DKK Brands is the driving force behind premium kitchenware brands Espro, Liiton, and VIVA. We take pride in designing, manufacturing, and distributing exceptional products to consumers. What truly motivates us is the satisfaction of seeing our products bring joy to our customers. Whether it’s a gift that stands out or a personal favorite, knowing that our products are among the best in their category reinforces our passion for delivering excellence.


About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced B2B Ecommerce Channel Manager for our Faire.com (US & CA) storefronts. to own and grow our wholesale marketplace presence. This is a hands-on role owning sales results and responsible for managing the end-to-end performance of the Faire.com channel—from product listings and promotions to retailer relationships, outreach and revenue growth.

You’ll work cross-functionally with marketing, operations, and leadership to ensure Faire.com storefronts are optimized as a high-performing wholesale sales channel.


Key Responsibilities

Faire.com Site Management:

  • Own daily operations of the Faire.com storefronts
  • Manage product listings, pricing, bundles, and merchandising
  • Ensure accurate inventory, lead times, and product availability
  • Monitor channel health, compliance, and site best practices

Revenue Growth & Performance:

  • Drive monthly revenue growth and retailer acquisition
  • Launch and manage promotions, campaigns, and Faire-funded incentives
  • Analyze performance metrics (revenue, AOV, conversion, reorders)
  • Identify opportunities to increase repeat orders and retailer lifetime value

Retailer Relationship Management:

  • Respond to retailer inquiries within 24 hours
  • Build strong relationships with new and existing wholesale partners
  • Support onboarding, reorders, and product education
  • Handle order issues, returns, and escalations professionally

Campaigns & Marketing Coordination:

  • Coordinate Faire promotions, brand sales, and seasonal campaigns
  • Collaborate with internal marketing team on launches and featured products
  • Support new product introductions on Faire

Reporting & Optimization:

  • Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports
  • Track KPIs and recommend data-driven improvements
  • Continuously test and optimize listings, pricing, and promotions (a/b testing)


Requirements

  • 2+ years experience in at a single company managing and owning Faire.com or similar wholesale online marketplace performance
  • Strong understanding of wholesale sales cycle, B2B/Retailer ecommerce, and pricing strategies
  • Experience working with US/North American premium brands
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Data-driven mindset with basic analytics skills
  • Excellent written English communication
  • Able to work EST hours consistently


Nice to Have

  • Experience with consumer goods, home, lifestyle, or beverage brands
  • Background in ecommerce, Amazon, or other marketplaces
  • Familiarity with inventory planning and demand forecasting


Performance Bonus Structure (Up to $500/month)

Bonus is tied to:

  • Revenue growth targets
  • Retailer acquisition and reorder rate
  • Campaign execution and channel optimization
  • Responsiveness and operational excellence


Why Join Us

  • 100% remote work with a stable company in a permanent full-time role
  • High bonus potential for top performers
  • Generous PTO program
  • Clear ownership of a high-impact revenue channel with opportunity to grow
  • High bonus potential for top performers
  • Discounted company merchandise


DKK Brands is an equal opportunity employer. Final compensation offers are based on experience and overall role fit and may differ from posting.

description:

Empresa con gran trayectoria y de alcance internacional, se encuentra en la búsqueda de un talento:Coordinador de Planeamiento y Demanda¿Cuál es la Misión del puesto?Liderar, integrar y hacer eficientes los procesos implicados en la cadena de suministro como son: estimación de la demanda, planificación de la cadena de abastecimiento, compras estratégicas, operaciones de planta y logística y transporte, lo cual implica una interacción y coordinación de acciones constante con los distintos referentes de áreas.Definir el plan de demanda, plan de abastecimiento a los COs, producción y abastecimiento de materias primas e insumos, liderando a su equipo para que se realice de acuerdo a lo acordado.Liderar los planes Estratégicos y planes de mediano y corto plazo de su área, así como liderar y desarrollar a su equipo en pos de la incorporación de prácticas modernas de Planeamiento.Plantear los objetivos del área en forma alineada con los objetivos de la Gerencia de Supply Chain y la Gerencia Corporativa.Liderar y acompañar en la mejora continua del portafolio de la compañía a través del Proceso de Racionalización de SKUs (Cure & Kill) a partir de comités multifuncionales con los diversos actores a lo largo de la Cadena de Suministro.Coordinar con las áreas de la compañía las tareas de limpieza de datos y mejora de procesos de ciclo de vida del producto.Asegurar que no se tengan quiebres a través del correcto balance de producción y abastecimiento a COs oportunamente.Velar por el Working Capital de la compañía a través de la administración de los inventarios de PT, MP y Repuestos.Contribuir y velar por el buen clima laboral, coordinando y participando en las diferentes actividades que se desarrollen en coordinación con las otras jefaturas de la empresa.Cumplir con las políticas y lineamientos de la empresa, del sistema integrado de gestión, política de las 5S, el RIT y el código de ética, así como del marco normativo del gobierno con la finalidad de contribuir con el desarrollo óptimo y adecuado de las diferentes actividades de la organización.¿Cuáles son los requisitos del puesto?Titulado en Administración, Ingeniería Industriasl o carreras afines.Contar con 3 años de experiencia viendo procesos S&OP y manejo de presupuesto. (Indispensable)Conocimiento en SAP y Office (Indispensable)Nivel de inglés Intermedio/avanzado (Deseable).Conocimientos en gestión de procesos, gestión por competencia y gestión al cambio.¿Qué te ofrecemos?Formar parte de una empresa líder en su sector.Planilla Completa.
